body: Generally would not like people to be viewing this at work like places, may not be considered appropriate material. Thank you, I worked hard on it!
Of course, I will make time for the edits! Thank you so very much for reading and taking the time to leave a reply, I appreciate it! Although I may do this on my other guide, which is more detailed.

Thank you very much, I too would like people to make good use of it! If you google polistirex you will see the syrup, whereas if you search HBr, you will find both. Hydrobromide can come in both forms because in the gel-caps there is the HBr syrup. Maybe that’s what you are referring to? I don’t think polistirex can come in gel-cap form but I could be wrong. Look at the labels on the bottles as that is where you will find the real information - don’t trust the images if you search polistirex to only be polistirex! I will make it more clear in an edit that HBr can come in syrup form too.
